Each entry has the form

- label is the LMFDB label of the modular curve;

- group_name is the group description of MAut returned by Magma and need not uniquely determine the isomorphism type of the abstract group;
- generators is a list of matrices in PGL(2,Q) representing generators of the corresponding modular automorphisms.
